Title: Branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new materials, and discloses a branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a branched polyaryl piperidine polymer with high conductivity and alkali stability and an anion exchange membrane. The anion exchange membrane takes p-terphenyl as a main structure of a polymer main chain; meanwhile, a hydrophilic phenyl-containing monomer (octaphenyl POSS and octaphenyl cyclotetrasiloxane) with a space structure is introduced into the polymer structure, and the monomer has a three-dimensional space structure and rigid hydrophilic characteristics, so that the polymer structure has a larger free volume, and a smoother ion transmission channel is established, thereby improving the electrochemical performance of the membrane; the method has a good application prospect in the aspect of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis. The prepared anion exchange membrane has relatively high conductivity and alkali stability, and can be applied to equipment such as a water electrolyser.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Title: Six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the field of alkaline fuel cells and electrolyzed water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: introducing tri (4-carbazole-9-yl phenyl) amine with six branching sites into a polymer main chain as a branching unit, and carrying out Friedel-Crafts alkylation copolymerization on the branched unit, p-terphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone under the catalysis of superacid to prepare a six-arm star-shaped branched polymer main chain; and performing quaternization on a piperidine ring in the main chain through a Michaku reaction to obtain the target anion exchange membrane. According to the star-shaped branched structure disclosed by the invention, the free volume in the membrane is obviously increased, and a micro-phase separation structure with larger size and stronger connectivity is induced to be formed; the anion exchange membrane has high hydroxyl conductivity, excellent alkali stability, good mechanical performance and outstanding fuel cell and water electrolysis performance, and has wide application prospects in the field of electrochemical energy devices.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Title: Polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, anion exchange membrane, and preparation method and application of polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application of the polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and the anion exchange membrane. A main chain of the polymer does not contain ether bonds and has cation 3-piperidine onium salt, so that the polymer has good alkali-resistant stability; through copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, modification of a polymer is realized, a polymer with a hydrophilic/hydrophobic controllable structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with excellent mechanical stability, ionic conductivity and alkali-resistant stability and relatively low swelling ratio is prepared. A membrane electrode further assembled by the prepared anion exchange membrane material can be used for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production and alkaline fuel cells.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; swelling control; mechanical stability; ionic conductivity

Title: Polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to preparation of a polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer. According to the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, a full-carbon-chain skeleton structure is adopted, a functional group, namely carbonyl, connected with an electron-rich benzene ring is migrated from a piperidine-containing ring to the fourth site or/and other sites of the piperidine ring, and polymerization of the aldehyde group and aromatic hydrocarbon is used for replacing traditional polymerization of ketone group and aromatic hydrocarbon, so that the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer is obtained. The piperidine ring is suspended outside the aryl main chain in the polymer, the rigid structure of the piperidine ring is reserved, and the anion transmission rate and chemical stability are further improved. According to the polymer structure, modification of the polymer is realized by using strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched and the like, and the polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone

Title: Main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a linear structure phenyl monomer, a strong bond energy linear structure phenyl monomer, 1, 2-diphenylethane and N-methyl-4-piperidone to obtain a precursor polymer solution; dropwise adding trifluoroacetic acid and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid to obtain a main chain type polyarene piperidine polymer precursor; and dissolving the polyaromatic piperidine, adding methyl iodide and potassium carbonate, reacting to obtain a quaternized main chain type polyaromatic piperidine polymer, and carrying out membrane treatment and alkali treatment processes to obtain the anion exchange membrane. By introducing the high-rigidity hydrophobic linear monomer with strong bond energy, the problem of mutual entanglement between linear main chains of a traditional polymer is solved, larger free volume and steric hindrance are provided, and high ionic conductivity and high alkali stability of the anion exchange membrane are realized; therefore, the water electrolysis performance of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank is further improved, and high-performance and high-stability electrolytic tank application is realized.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Title: Self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and particularly discloses a self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The poly (aryl piperidine) polymer is selected as a main chain without an ether bond, the cyclic piperidinium is selected as a cationic group, the chemical stability of the membrane material can be effectively improved, the free volume of the interior of the membrane material is increased by introducing a meta-terphenyl monomer with a bent conformation into a polymer structural unit, ion transmission is facilitated, and the membrane material has a good application prospect. And a self-crosslinking network is introduced to further promote the formation of an ionic conduction high-speed channel, and meanwhile, the excessive swelling of the membrane is limited, so that the ionic conductivity and mechanical stability of the membrane are improved. The prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; crosslinking; swelling control; mechanical stability; ionic conductivity

Title: Dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of macromolecules, and particularly discloses a dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer, which successfully overcomes the defect that a main chain of a traditional polyarylether material is easy to break and degrade under a strong alkali condition by introducing a dibenzofuran structure, improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, and has a good application prospect. A benzene ring, quaternary ammonium or piperidine cation group is introduced by utilizing a side chain suspension strategy, microphase separation in the polymer is effectively promoted, and an efficient ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the membrane material has good hydroxyl ion conductivity which can be up to 170.2 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C while a relatively low swelling rate is maintained, and the membrane material can be widely applied to the field of membrane materials. The polymer shows excellent mechanical properties, the tensile strength of a dry film is excellent, the alkali-resistant durability is excellent, and the conductivity loss is small when the polymer is soaked in a strong alkali (KOH) solution at 80 DEG C for more than 1800 hours. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has good application value in the fields of fuel cells, water electrolysis hydrogen production and the like, and shows strong commercial potential.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; swelling control; ionic conductivity

Title: Polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-molecular polymer membrane materials, and discloses a polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise an aryl monomer and 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde, or the aryl monomer, the 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde and a branching agent. A benzyl-containing piperidinium molecular framework is designed, a piperidine ring is connected with a main chain through a flexible spacer, meanwhile, benzyl is connected to an N atom, and the benzyl has large steric hindrance, so that the stability of AEM under an alkaline condition, especially under a high-temperature and high-concentration severe condition, is effectively relieved. Branching agents such as triphenylbenzene are added into a main chain structure to enhance the mechanical property and alkali-resistant stability of the main chain structure, and the polymer electrolyte membrane with high conductivity, high mechanical property and high alkali resistance is prepared by adopting a simple solution casting method and is applied to AEMWE.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Title: Enhanced anion exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and preparation method of enhanced anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses an enhanced anion-exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and a preparation method of the enhanced anion-exchange membrane. The enhanced anion exchange membrane is composed of polymer resin A (side chain functionalized poly (p-terphenyl piperidine) polymer) and a base material modified by a semi-interpenetrating polymer (SIPN). The polymer resin takes alkali-resistant polyterphenyl piperidine as a main chain and is laterally grafted with a quaternary ammonium cation alkyl side chain containing a hydrophilic group, transmission sites of OH <-> are increased under the condition that the functionalization degree of the main chain is certain, and a microphase separation form is effectively constructed through interaction of the hydrophobic polymer main chain and the hydrophilic functionalized alkyl side chain, so that the polymer resin is prepared. The ionic conductivity of the membrane is greatly improved. According to a semi-interpenetrating network structure formed based on SIPN, high-molecular resin and a base material are tightly combined, and the problem that a composite membrane in the market is too high in gas permeability is solved.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity; crossover / permeability

Title: High-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of membrane materials. The high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane provided by the invention is obtained by carrying out self-polymerization on a branched monomer or carrying out copolymerization on the branched monomer, a biphenyl monomer and N-methyl-4-piperidone and then carrying out quaternization conversion. The free volume of the anion exchange membrane is larger than that of a linear polymer, so that the anion exchange membrane shows ultrahigh conductivity; due to a high-molecular-weight polymer main chain (Mn is greater than 100K), the polymer has excellent alkali-resistant stability and mechanical strength; meanwhile, the anion exchange membrane has low water absorption swelling rate and dimensional stability, is suitable for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and alkaline fuel cells, and has wide application prospects.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; swelling control; mechanical stability; ionic conductivity

Title: Piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, preparation method and application of alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion exchange membranes, and discloses a piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, a preparation method of the piperidine anion exchange membrane and application of an alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing piperidine type trimonomer polymers containing anthracene and derivatives thereof in different proportions; then, carrying out quaternization on the polymers by directly taking piperidone of the polymers as functional sites to obtain a membrane material; and preparing the membrane. According to the invention, by introducing anthracene and derivative monomers thereof and utilizing a pi-pi accumulation effect, a functional group anchored on a main chain is induced to self-assemble, so that the formation of a microphase separation structure can be promoted, the water-resistant plasticizing capability of a hydrophobic phase is enhanced, and the swelling of a membrane is inhibited. By adjusting the proportion of the anthracene and the derivative monomer thereof to the p-terphenyl monomer, the rigidity of the polymer can be enhanced, the free volume of the polymer can be expanded, and the dimensional stability and the ion transport capacity of the polymer can be improved. The prepared membrane has good alkali stability and mechanical strength and can be applied to alkaline membrane electrolyzed water.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; swelling control; mechanical stability; ionic conductivity

Title: Preparation and application of branched poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material with high free volume
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and preparation of the high-performance anion exchange membranes, and particularly discloses a branched poly (aryl piperidine)-based anion exchange membrane material with a high free volume as well as a preparation method and application of the branched poly (aryl piperidine)-based anion exchange membrane material. A branching agent 9, 9-diphenylfluorene is introduced into a polymer structural unit, so that the free volume in the membrane material is increased, meanwhile, the movement capacity of part of chain segments is limited, swelling of the membrane material due to water absorption is inhibited, the ionic conductivity and the dimensional stability of the membrane material are effectively improved, and the prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

Title: Norbornene-containing bis-benzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane material containing norbornene dibenzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine as well as a preparation method and application of the anion exchange membrane material, and relates to the field of anion exchange membrane materials for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. According to the invention, norbornene bis-benzocyclobutane is introduced into a polymer main chain of aromatic hydrocarbon and piperidone to form a distorted and difficult-to-rotate space structure. By adopting the technical scheme, the structural rigidity and larger free volume of a polymer skeleton are improved, the formation of a large number of microporous structures is promoted, the agglomeration of ion clusters is facilitated, more phase separation structures are formed, and the ionic conductivity of the membrane material is improved through the synergistic effect of the two, so that the membrane material is more stable in performance. And meanwhile, the problem of relatively poor dimensional stability caused by excessive water absorption of the membrane material is inhibited, and the prepared anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in the field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis.

Title: Polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and discloses a polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and an application of the anion exchange membrane in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. Polypropylene is used as a polymer main chain, and benzyl chloride active reaction sites are given to an intermediate film through radiation grafting; further, accurate cross-linking is realized among polymer chain segments through a Menshutkin reaction. Two different flexible cross-linking agents are selected to respectively form different cross-linked networks, so that the defects of weak mechanical property and poor dimensional stability of an uncross-linked film are effectively overcome; and meanwhile, coupling optimization of ionic conductivity, mechanical properties and dimensional stability of the membrane material is realized by precisely regulating and controlling the amination and crosslinking ratio. The anion exchange membrane material shows excellent comprehensive performance and good application potential in related electrochemical application due to the structural matching of the main chain and the side chain and the synergistic balance of multiple gains and multiple properties of the crosslinking effect.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; crosslinking; swelling control; ionic conductivity

Title: Branched quinine-based polymer, preparation method and application of branched quinine-based polymer in anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a branched quinine-based polymer, a preparation method and application of the branched quinine-based polymer in an anion exchange membrane, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy utilization and high polymer material preparation. The branched quinine-based polymer comprises a quinine ring structural unit, an aromatic structural unit, a crosslinking structural unit and a functional structural unit R1, and is applied to preparation of an anion exchange membrane. The technical limitation of single performance optimization of an existing anion exchange membrane is broken through, a high-steric-hindrance quinine cation group and a planar three-dimensional/stereoscopic four-dimensional branched cross-linked structure are subjected to molecular-level organic combination, triple technical cooperation of an ether-bond-free polymer skeleton, a quinine steric hindrance effect and branched structure free volume regulation and control is realized, and the high-performance anion exchange membrane is prepared. The industrial common problem that alkali resistance, ionic conductivity and mechanical strength of an existing membrane material are difficult to consider at the same time is solved from the molecular structure design level; the alkali-resistant stable operation time and the conductivity retention rate achieve qualitative breakthrough, the comprehensive performance is excellent, and the composite material is widely applied to hydrogen energy conversion devices such as alkaline fuel cells and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production.
Technical Issues / Solutions: crosslinking; mechanical stability; ionic conductivity

Title: Polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, anion exchange membrane and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. According to the polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, the density of functional groups is further improved after side chains are grafted, and the ion exchange capacity and the ion conductivity are remarkably improved when the functional groups are correspondingly applied to an anion exchange membrane; a hydrophobic structure unit is introduced into a main chain, so that a hydrophilic-hydrophobic microphase separation structure is optimized, the swelling degree of the anion exchange membrane is reduced, and the chemical stability is improved; in addition, the molecular weight of a polymer main chain can be controlled by controlling the feeding proportion of the monomers, so that the mechanical property of the diaphragm can be improved.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; swelling control; ionic conductivity

Main Topic: Topic 2 - AEM polymer chemistry and membrane stability
Title: Poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane prepared from poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to a poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer. According to the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer and the anion exchange membrane, a skeleton structure of a full-carbon main chain is adopted, a piperidine ring is far away from a rigid main chain skeleton to enhance the mobility of ions and improve the alkaline stability of quaternary ammonium salt cations, and modification of the polymer is realized through copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit; a polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with ultrahigh stability is prepared.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone

Main Topic: Topic 2 - AEM polymer chemistry and membrane stability
Title: Preparation method and application of branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells and water electrolysis hydrogen production anion exchange membranes. According to the invention, a branched polyarylpiperidine main chain is constructed by introducing a multi-aromatic ring branched unit with multiple reaction sites into a conventional linear polyarylpiperidine main chain, so that the bulk density of the main chain is reduced, formation of ion clusters is facilitated, and the conductivity of the membrane is improved. And the branching degree can be regulated and controlled by flexibly adjusting the feeding of the multi-aromatic-ring branched monomer. The conductivity of the branched polyaryl piperidine membrane is increased by more than 26% compared with that of a linear membrane, and the branched membrane has a lower swelling ratio and higher hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell power density and water electrolysis hydrogen production performance.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; swelling control; ionic conductivity

Title: Multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method of the multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: carrying out polycondensation on an aromatic compound, N-methylpiperidone and 3-quinuclidinone hydrochloride under the catalysis of superacid to obtain a polymer intermediate; carrying out quaternization reaction on the polymer intermediate, end-halogenated perfluoro long-chain alkane and methyl iodide, and introducing a hydrophobic side chain to obtain membrane powder; and finally, dissolving the film powder and coating to form the film. The 3-quinuclidone is introduced to participate in copolymerization, so that the molecular weight and the alkali resistance of a main chain of the polymer are effectively improved; meanwhile, by introducing a perfluoroalkane hydrophobic side chain, a hydrophilic-hydrophobic phase separation structure is constructed, and an effective ion transmission channel is formed. The obtained multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane has the advantages of low swelling ratio, high mechanical strength, high chemical stability, strong alkali resistance, low membrane resistance and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; swelling control; mechanical stability

Title: Ionic polymer based on flexible main chain, anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention provides an ionic polymer based on a flexible main chain, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: mixing 1, 7-dichloro-4-heptanone and a trimethylamine solution in a first organic solvent to obtain N1, N1, N1, N7, N7, N7-hexamethyl-4-oxoheptane-1, 7-ammonium dichloride; mixing the ionic polymer with a hydroxyl-containing all-carbon flexible polymer main chain and aromatic aldehyde and/or aromatic ketone in the presence of a second organic solvent and a catalyst to obtain an ionic polymer based on the flexible main chain; and mixing the ionic polymer based on the flexible main chain with a third organic solvent, drying the mixed solution to form a membrane, and soaking the membrane in an alkali solution to obtain the anion exchange membrane of which the anion is hydroxyl. The ionic polymer and/or anion exchange membrane based on the flexible main chain prepared by the invention has the characteristics of excellent mechanical properties, high ionic conductivity, low swelling ratio, high antioxidant stability, high alkali-resistant stability, high fuel cell performance and high water electrolysis performance.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; swelling control; ionic conductivity

Title: Side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof and anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to a side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, a preparation method and application thereof and an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy. The preparation method of the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: reacting a side chain type polyaryl skeleton polymer with a quaternization reagent to obtain a side chain type polyaryl anion polymer; the side-chain type polyaryl anion polymer is subjected to membrane forming, and the side-chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane is obtained. According to the invention, a heteroatom-free polyaryl structure is selected as a main chain, and a super-acid-catalyzed Friedel-Crafts reaction is adopted for polymerization, so that the high-molecular polymer is obtained; the cationic functional group is a piperidine cationic functional group with excellent alkali stability; the piperidine cation functional group is connected with the polyaryl main chain through a long alkyl chain. According to the invention, a long alkyl chain is adopted to combine a polyaryl skeleton with a piperidine cation functional group, and a hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure is constructed in the membrane, so that the conductivity of hydroxyl ions is remarkably improved while the alkali stability and the size stability are improved.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Title: Crosslinked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material for water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and preparation of the high-performance anion exchange membranes, and particularly discloses a cross-linked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application of the cross-linked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material. Polycation side chains are introduced into a polymer structure unit to improve the aggregation degree of ions, and meanwhile, a cross-linked structure is introduced to limit the chain spacing, so that the local OH <-> concentration in the membrane is reduced. Secondly, a benzene ring flexible side chain is used as an interval between ions, the charge induction effect between the ions and a skeleton structure is reduced, the ionic conductivity and chemical resistance stability of the membrane material are effectively improved, and the prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; crosslinking; ionic conductivity

Title: Side-chain quinine-based polymer, preparation method and application of side-chain quinine-based polymer in preparation of anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides a side-chain quinine-based polymer, a preparation method and application of the side-chain quinine-based polymer in preparation of an anion exchange membrane, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells and hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing a quinine-based polymer with good alkali resistance from an aromatic monomer, a functional monomer and a quinine monomer through a super-acid catalytic condensation reaction, and secondly, preparing a side-chain quinine-based polymer based on the synthesized quinine-based polymer; and finally, carrying out film casting by taking the side-chain quinine polymer as a main chain polymer, and obtaining the high-performance all-carbon-chain anion exchange membrane in a modification mode of grafting a side chain. The alkaline anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has excellent chemical stability, ionic conductivity, mechanical property and comprehensive performance, and can be applied to the fields of alkaline fuel cells, water electrolysis, energy storage cells, carbon dioxide conversion, electrodialysis and other electrochemical devices.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; ionic conductivity

Main Topic: Topic 2 - AEM polymer chemistry and membrane stability
Title: Polymer, cross-linked anion-exchange membrane and preparation method and application of cross-linked anion-exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides a polymer, a cross-linked anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane, aryl compounds, trifluoroketone compounds and N-methylpiperidone are polymerized to form a main chain, the main chain has excellent rigidity and flexibility, a quaternary ammonium salt alkenyl compound is introduced as a cross-linking agent, cross-linking is completed through heating in the membrane forming process, and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane is prepared. The quaternary ammonium salt side chain introduced into the side chain has excellent hydrophilic and hydrophobic phase separation characteristics. The polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane have excellent oxidation-reduction resistance and alkali resistance, have the characteristics of stable physical and chemical properties, excellent ion flux, excellent mechanical properties (the elongation at break is greater than 60%) and simple process, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Technical Issues / Solutions: polymer backbone; crosslinking

Main Topic: Topic 2 - AEM polymer chemistry and membrane stability
Title: Crosslinking type piperidine anion exchange membrane for alkaline electrolytic tank and preparation method of crosslinking type piperidine anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and particularly relates to a cross-linked piperidine anion exchange membrane for an alkaline electrolytic tank and a preparation method of the cross-linked piperidine anion exchange membrane. Aiming at the problem of degradation in an alkaline environment in the prior art, the invention provides the cross-linked piperidine anion exchange membrane for the alkaline electrolytic tank and the preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a phenyl structure monomer with a branched group, a phenyl structure monomer with a linear structure and an N-methyl-4-piperidone monomer into a first solvent; carrying out polymerization reaction in the presence of a catalyst; separating out a crude polymer product; after dissolving, adding methyl iodide and p-chloromethyl styrene, finally adding potassium carbonate, and pouring the solution after reaction into a fourth solvent for precipitation; and adding an initiator, dissolving the initiator in a fifth solvent, and casting the membrane casting solution into a membrane to prepare the cross-linked piperidine anion exchange membrane. The invention provides a novel main chain structure, and polysulfone and polyether-ether-ketone which are commonly used in the prior art are not adopted as main chains, so that the polysulfone-polyether-ether-ketone copolymer has better chemical stability.
Technical Issues / Solutions: chemical stability; polymer backbone; crosslinking

Title: Anionic polymer, anion exchange membrane, method and electrolyzed water reactor
Abstract: The invention provides an anionic polymer, an anion exchange membrane, a method and an electrolytic water reactor, the anionic polymer selects a polyaryl skeleton structure, and the polyaryl skeleton structure is connected with a cationic group with high alkali resistance and a fluorine-containing side chain structure; according to the anion exchange membrane prepared from the anionic polymer, a cationic group with high alkali resistance and a side chain structure for providing an in-situ polymerization site are introduced into a polymer skeleton structure containing a fluorine-containing structural unit, so that the alkali-resistant stability and the dimensional stability are improved while the high ion conductivity of the anion exchange membrane is maintained; the comprehensive optimization and improvement of the performance of the anion exchange membrane are realized.

Title: Polyaryl quinine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane prepared from polyaryl quinine polymer

Title: Ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof and belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion-exchange membranes. The ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane is characterized in that firstly, an ether oxygen bond-free aryl polymer with good solubility and stability is synthesized, then with amino groups of the polymer serving as grafting sites, the polymer is subjected to functionalized grafting to obtain a membrane material, and the membrane material is made into the membrane. The prepared membrane has good alkaline stability and high ion conductivity and can be applied to alkaline polymer electrolytic cells.

Title: Anion exchange polymer, anion exchange membrane, method and device
Abstract: According to the anion exchange polymer, the anion exchange membrane, the method and the device provided by the invention, a cationic group with high alkali resistance is introduced into a polyaryl polymer structure, and meanwhile, a cationic side chain is introduced, so that the ionic conductivity and the alkali-resistant stability of the anion exchange polymer are synchronously improved; the anion exchange membrane prepared from the anion exchange polymer has the advantages of excellent ionic conductivity and alkali-resistant stability, can stably operate for a long time in a high pH value environment, and is not easy to degrade or reduce the performance. Therefore, the anion exchange membrane has remarkable advantages in electrochemical processes such as water electrolysis hydrogen production, so that the anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in electrochemical devices such as a water electrolysis reactor and the like.

Title: Branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a branched polymer precursor, preparing a quaternized branched polymer, and preparing the branched anion exchange membrane: dissolving the quaternized branched polymer in a third solvent, and drying in a vacuum drying oven to obtain the branched anion exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions, and soaking the branched anion-exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions in a NaOH solution for ion exchange, so that the branched anion-exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions is completely converted into a form of hydroxyl ions. According to the invention, ether-free skeleton polyaromatic hydrocarbon is selected as a main chain and has the characteristic of strong alkali-resistant stability, six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic ions are adopted as functional groups, and a large steric hindrance structure can hinder nucleophilic substitution and elimination reaction, so that the alkali-resistant stability of the anion exchange membrane is improved, and the service life of the anion exchange membrane is prolonged.

Title: Ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method thereof based on interface confinement
Abstract: The invention provides a ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method thereof based on interface confinement. The preparation method of the ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor solution containing ferrous ions and ferric ions; the foamed nickel substrate is cleaned; the cleaned foamed nickel is tightly attached to the surface of the bottom of the reaction container, the foamed nickel is immersed in the precursor solution, under the room-temperature standing condition, divalent and trivalent iron ions are induced to be subjected to a synergistic hydrolysis and coprecipitation reaction through a physical interface confinement space formed by an attached interface, and the nickel-based composite material is obtained. Therefore, a high-activity and high-uniformity nickel-iron-based (oxygen) hydroxide catalyst layer (DIC-NiFeOOH/NF) is grown on the surface of the foamed nickel in situ. The method is simple in process, green and energy-saving, and the prepared nickel-iron-based oxygen evolution electrode shows excellent performance in oxygen evolution reaction and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis.

Title: Nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof. A cleaned substrate nickel felt is soaked in a metal salt solution, taken out, subjected to vacuum drying and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere, and the self-supporting electrode can be prepared. The formed catalyst particles are in a nickel-iron-cobalt alloy state and grow in dense pores of the nickel fibers, and the unique self-supporting structure is beneficial to proceeding of the mass transfer process, reduction of charge transfer resistance and improvement of electrode stability. When the electrode is used for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the current density is as high as 2.3 A cm <-2 > under the cell pressure of 2.0 V. During a durability test, the electrode maintains stability for more than 1400 hours at a current density of 1 A cm <-2 >. The preparation process does not need to use a binder, the production cost is reduced, and the catalyst is expected to be applied to the actual water electrolysis hydrogen production process due to excellent catalytic performance and durability.

Title: Self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrode is obtained by combining a hydrothermal method and an electro-deposition method; according to the electrode, a manganese-doped basic cobalt carbonate nanowire vertically grows on the surface of foamed nickel, and the periphery of the nanowire is wrapped with a plurality of lamellar nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets to form a whole nanorod. The nanorods are uniform in size, the length of the nanorods is 2-3 microns, the diameter of the nanorods is 100-500 nm, and the nanorods vertically grow on the surface of the foamed nickel; the electrode has relatively high catalytic activity and stability, and after foamed nickel is used as a conductive substrate, the electrode can still stably run for a long time in a strong alkaline medium under relatively high electrolytic current; the electrode is applied to water electrolysis hydrogen production and oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: High-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as preparation method and application of high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, in particular to a high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method and application of the high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The problems that in an existing anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the OER overpotential is high, a catalyst layer is prone to falling off under the ampere-level current density, the preparation method is complex, and large-scale preparation is difficult are solved. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding ferric nitrate into isopropanol, and violently stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution A; thiourea is added into deionized water to be dissolved, and a solution B is obtained; adding the solution B into the solution A under violent stirring to obtain a uniform solution C; and 2) putting the metal porous material substrate subjected to ultrasonic cleaning with ethanol and a hydrochloric acid solution into the solution C for dipping, then taking out the metal porous material substrate, washing the metal porous material substrate with a large amount of deionized water, and drying the metal porous material substrate to obtain the integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The prepared oxygen evolution catalyst not only has high oxygen evolution catalytic activity, but also is tightly combined with a substrate, and long-term stable operation with ampere-level current density can be realized.

Title: High-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, a preparation method and application, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, uniformly mixing a certain amount of nickel salt solution and a certain amount of iron salt solution respectively, and then putting an activated nickel-containing substrate material into the mixed solution; and 2, depositing at room temperature for a certain time to obtain the catalytic electrode with a ferro-nickel double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst growing on the surface. The invention designs a synthesis method for normal-temperature in-situ growth of a nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) oxygen evolution catalyst on a nickel-containing substrate material, low-cost batch green synthesis with nearly 100% of raw material utilization rate, zero waste liquid and no size limitation is realized, and the obtained catalytic electrode has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic performance and long-time stability; the method can be directly applied to alkaline (ALK) electrolytic baths and anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolytic baths, the cost of the ALK electrolytic baths and the AEM electrolytic baths is remarkably reduced, and the method has important industrial application value.

Title: Cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production catalysis. The preparation method of the cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst comprises the following steps: mixing cobalt oxide and iron oxide, carrying out dispersion treatment by using isopropanol after first grinding, and then carrying out ball milling, cooling, washing and drying to obtain a precursor; and mixing the precursor and lithium chloride, performing secondary grinding, and sintering to obtain the ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst. The cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of high activity, high stability, long service life and low cost, can be used as an oxygen evolution catalyst of systems such as alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, has excellent catalytic performance, and can greatly reduce the energy consumption of water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Hollow array oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water. A self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode is obtained through a hydrothermal method in an alkaline medium; foamy copper is used as a substrate, the electrode structure comprises an outer layer consisting of a plurality of layered nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets and an inner layer consisting of cuprous sulfide hollow nanorods, and the final morphology characteristics are as follows: the average diameter of each nanorod is 100-500nm, and the length of each nanorod is 2-3mu m; the electrode can effectively control the morphology of a synthetic catalyst under mild conditions, and has good catalytic activity and stability. The electrode is applied to the oxygen evolution reaction in the water electrolysis hydrogen production process under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. According to the method, the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode directly and vertically grown on a nickel fiber felt substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method. The electrode prepared by the method is applied to the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. Wherein the obtained nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is in a nanoflower shape extending outwards from the center, the particle diameter of the nanoflower is 500 nm to 5 [mu] m, and the thickness of the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is 5 to 10 [mu] m; the thickness of the nickel fiber felt ranges from 0.25 mm to 0.4 mm. As a three-dimensional skeleton of foamed nickel easily punctures an anionic membrane, the performance and long-term operation life of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) are influenced. Therefore, the nickel fiber felt is adopted as the substrate, and the problems can be effectively solved. In addition, the invention has wide utilization value in renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that the surface of a foamed nickel sheet is cleaned and dried, and a clean oil-free foamed nickel sheet is obtained; dissolving nickel nitrate, ferric nitrate and ammonium heptamolybdate in deionized water to obtain dispersion liquid; transferring the dispersion liquid into a hydrothermal kettle, putting a foamed nickel sheet into the hydrothermal kettle, carrying out hydrothermal treatment in a drying oven, naturally cooling, washing and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with nickel molybdate and iron molybdate catalysts; and preparing an ionomer solution, spraying the ionomer solution onto the electrode precursor, and drying to obtain the oxygen evolution catalytic electrode. The invention provides a preparation scheme of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution catalytic electrode which is simple in preparation method, low in synthesis cost, non-toxic and harmless, and the catalyst in the electrode has a microstructure different from that of a common molybdate catalyst and has high electrochemical catalytic activity. The electrolytic bath based on the catalytic electrode can efficiently electrolyze dilute alkali liquor to produce hydrogen, and the energy consumption and the safety of the electrolytic bath are superior to those of a traditional alkaline water electrolysis system.

Title: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
Abstract: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. The perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst is composed of a main phase perovskite oxide substrate with electrochemical activity and a nanosheet proton conductor beta-NaFeO2 with excellent proton affinity. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode as well as preparation method and application of thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure (Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF) composite electrode. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cutting and cleaning the foamed nickel substrate; the preparation method comprises the following steps: growing a nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet on a foamed nickel substrate through a constant-voltage deposition method; nickel-cobalt-iron prussian blue analogue nanoparticles grow in situ on the surface of the nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet through an ion exchange method; and preparing the Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF composite electrode through a thermal shock method. The composite electrode has excellent catalytic activity and stability as a working electrode for hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution reactions. The composite electrode can be directly used as a cathode and an anode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell to efficiently catalyze a full-water decomposition reaction at different temperatures, and the electrolytic cell can stably operate for 1000 hours and 240 hours under the current densities of 0.1 A cm <-2 > and 1.0 A cm <-2 > respectively, so that the composite electrode has a good application prospect.

Title: Preparation method and application of non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst. The catalyst provided by the invention comprises nickel selenide nanoparticles and graphene quantum dots loaded on the surfaces of the nickel selenide nanoparticles, wherein the mass ratio of the graphene quantum dots to the nickel selenide nanoparticles is (1-8): 50. The graphene quantum dots can be loaded on the surface of nickel selenide through a simple hydrothermal reaction, the preparation method is simple and convenient, the overpotential of an oxygen evolution reaction can be greatly reduced while the cost of the prepared catalyst is reduced, and the catalyst has relatively high electrochemical performance and stability in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and is suitable for industrial production. Title: Preparation method of self-supporting nickel-based oxygen evolution electrode based on magnetron sputtering technology
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a self-supporting nickel-based oxygen evolution electrode based on a magnetron sputtering technology, which comprises the following steps: selecting a nickel-based porous transmission layer as a base material, and improving the surface roughness of the base material by using the magnetron sputtering technology and a corrosion process. Title: Oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention provides an oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, a preparation method and application, and relates to the technical field of electro-catalysis nanometer material preparation.According to the oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, a heterostructure formed by combining nickel sulfide and iron phosphide is obtained on the surface of a nickel net, and the heterostructure serves as the oxygen evolution catalyst electrode and is applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser; the activation and reaction stability of the electro-catalysis oxygen evolution reaction are improved, and the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 > and 100 mAcm <-2 > can be obtained only through 226 mV overpotential and 258 mV overpotential respectively. Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water. Title: Preparation method of self-supporting anode catalyst, catalyst and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a self-supporting anode catalyst, the catalyst and application of the catalyst, and relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalysts.The method comprises the steps that a foamed ferronickel substrate is provided and pretreated; immersing the pretreated foamed ferronickel substrate into the first precursor solution for standing reaction, forming a transition metal sulfide layer on the surface of the substrate through in-situ growth, and washing and drying to obtain an intermediate product; and placing the intermediate product in a second precursor solution for hydrothermal reaction, and growing on the surface of the transition metal sulfide layer to form a layered double hydroxide catalyst layer, thereby obtaining the self-supporting anode catalyst with a three-layer structure of layered double hydroxide, transition metal oxide and foamed ferronickel. Title: Oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and preparation method of oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention aims at providing an oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and a preparation method of the oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. Title: Preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving a soluble nickel salt and a soluble cobalt salt in deionized water, mixing the two solutions, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to prepare a precursor reaction solution; adding 85% phosphoric acid solution and 98% sulfuric acid solution into the precursor reaction solution, and shearing; putting the obtained solution into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, reacting under a high-temperature condition, and centrifuging, cleaning and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor after the reaction; and calcining the catalyst precursor in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The method has the advantages that a hydrothermal calcination synthesis method is adopted, phosphorus and sulfur are introduced in the preparation process, the non-noble metal AEM water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst is synthesized, the electron conduction capacity of the catalyst is remarkably improved, and the catalytic activity and stability of the catalyst are improved.

Title: Halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst, preparation and application thereof in anion exchange membrane electrolysis hydrogen production technology
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and relates to a halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst, preparation and application of the halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production technology. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving trivalent ferric salt without halogen atoms and halide in water, wherein the halide is sodium or potassium halide; the preparation method comprises the following steps: soaking a nickel matrix in a solution, reacting Fe < 3 + > and Ni in the solution to generate Ni < 2 + > and Fe < 2 + >, further reacting Fe < 2 + > and O2 to increase the pH value of the solution, and forming the halogen-doped ferronickel-based catalyst on the surface of the nickel matrix by Ni < 2 + >, Fe < 3 + >, halogen ions and OH <-> in the solution in the pH increasing process. The catalyst is a non-noble metal catalyst, the raw materials are low in cost, the reaction temperature of preparation is close to the room temperature, the preparation steps are simple, the catalyst activity is high, the catalyst is suitable for large-scale production, in addition, the catalyst has good charge transfer capacity, and the excellent electrolytic hydrogen production performance is shown after the catalyst is constructed into an anion exchange membrane electrolytic hydrogen production anode.

Title: NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: removing oil stain and an oxide layer on the surface of foamed nickel; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel nitrate and ammonium molybdate in deionized water, putting the solution and foamed nickel into a high-pressure reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction, and growing NiMoO4 on a foamed nickel substrate in situ; after the reaction is finished, cleaning and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with NiMoO4; soaking the Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam in a ferric salt solution to obtain Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam; and soaking the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x catalyst in alkali liquor, cleaning and drying to obtain the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst. Title: Iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrode materials and industrial catalysis, and particularly relates to an iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material and a preparation method and application thereof. Title: Anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing nickel salt, ferric salt and ammonium fluoride as a solution A; preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing potassium hydroxide and potassium carbonate as a solution B; and dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A at a constant speed under the conditions of normal pressure, 25 DEG C and stirring, curing, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain the NiFe-based layered double hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst. Controllable coprecipitation at normal pressure and low temperature is achieved through the synergistic effect of the water/isopropanol binary solvent, NH4F regulation and control and the KOH/K2CO3 compound alkali source, and the obtained catalyst is loose in morphology, rich in active sites and excellent in charge transmission performance. The method is simple in process, easy in parameter control and clear in amplification path, and the prepared catalyst is used for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode oxygen evolution reaction and has low overpotential and high stability.

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, preparation method, electrolytic bath and electrolysis method
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, a preparation method, an electrolytic bath and an electrolysis method. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning and vacuum drying on foamed nickel to obtain pretreated foamed nickel; s2, immersing the pretreated foamed nickel into the deposition liquid, performing deposition preparation by adopting a cathode cyclic voltammetry deposition method under a three-electrode system, taking out and cleaning the deposited foamed nickel, and performing vacuum drying to obtain nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite; s3, putting the obtained nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite into a reaction kettle filled with a selenylation solution, putting the reaction kettle into a drying oven, carrying out heat preservation reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, washing, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain a nickel-cobalt-manganese selenide precursor; and S4, putting the obtained nickel cobalt manganese selenide precursor into a plasma cleaning machine, and treating the front surface and the back surface with plasma to obtain the nickel cobalt manganese selenide. Title: Nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) taking foamed nickel as a substrate, cleaning and airing; 2) adding deionized water into nickel salt and molybdate until the volume is 1 L, performing ultrasonic treatment, stirring, and adjusting the pH value to obtain a precursor solution; (3) soaking the substrate obtained in the step (1) into the precursor solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction; naturally cooling, washing and drying; a precursor material is obtained; and 4) heating the precursor material to 400-600 DEG C in a reducing atmosphere, and keeping the temperature for 2-3 hours to obtain the nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient. Title: Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as a preparation method and an application of the Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst. The catalyst is prepared by taking nickel and cerium ions as precursors through a one-step controllable incomplete reduction method, the process is simple, the yield is close to 100%, and the catalyst is suitable for mass production. In the catalyst, CeO2 effectively promotes water molecule dissociation, NiO species finely regulates and controls a hydrogen intermediate (H *) adjacent to a nickel active site to adsorb free energy, the bottleneck problems that a traditional nickel-based material is too high in H * adsorption and slow in water dissociation kinetics are synergistically solved, the catalyst shows excellent hydrogen evolution reaction activity in a 1M KOH electrolyte, and the catalyst can be applied to the field of hydrogen production. The overpotential is only 62 mV (relative to a reversible hydrogen electrode) under the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 >, and the performance is equivalent to that of a commercial 60% Pt/C catalyst; after the electrode is pressed into an integral electrode, the electrode can stably run for 300 hours under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 > without activity attenuation. The catalyst disclosed by the invention is suitable for cathode hydrogen evolution reaction of alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water systems, and has an important industrial application prospect.
Technical Issues / Solutions: overpotential; high current density; nickel-based catalyst

Main Topic: Topic 3 - OER catalysts and catalytic electrodes
Title: Self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electro-catalysis water decomposition, in particular to a self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method, the NiCoFe-based (NiCoFe-Bi) oxygen evolution catalyst containing the borate radical intercalation layer is prepared by adopting a simple electro-deposition method. When being applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) tank for electrocatalytic water decomposition, the NiCoFe-Bi catalyst is efficient and stable through the leaching-redeposition self-repairing process of a Fe catalytic active center in cooperation with use of a KOH self-repairing electrolyte containing Fe < 2 + > ions and borate ions. The OER catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, high activity and ultra-long-term stability, the preparation method is simple, and powerful support is provided for the development of electro-catalytic water decomposition.
Technical Issues / Solutions: OER activity; catalyst stability; cobalt-based catalyst

Main Topic: Topic 3 - OER catalysts and catalytic electrodes
Title: Electrolytic water self-supporting catalytic material based on electrostatic adsorption as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an electrolytic water self-supporting catalytic material based on electrostatic adsorption and a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials.The self-supporting catalytic material comprises a self-supporting substrate and a nickel-molybdenum catalyst layer loaded on the surface of the self-supporting substrate; and non-noble metal active metal elements are introduced into the nickel-molybdenum catalyst layer through electrostatic adsorption, so that a highly-oriented metal crystal face structure is formed. The self-supporting catalytic material has excellent performance in an anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water test, has excellent stability and long service life by constructing a stable crystal face, and solves the problems of low activity, poor stability and the like of an existing non-noble metal hydrogen evolution catalytic material in anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water.
Technical Issues / Solutions: nickel-based catalyst

Main Topic: Topic 3 - OER catalysts and catalytic electrodes
Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting catalytic electrode of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting catalytic electrode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath, foamed nickel is used as a substrate, non-noble metals such as iron, cerium and the like and non-metals such as sulfur, phosphorus and the like are selected as raw materials, and a catalyst is grown on the substrate in situ by means of chemical impregnation, hydrothermal synthesis and chemical vapor deposition technologies. The composite material is applied to seawater electrolysis, high seawater electrolysis activity is kept, meanwhile, good electrolysis stability is achieved, excellent chlorine corrosion resistance is shown, and the composite material has excellent structure and chemical stability. Moreover, the anode material supports large-scale preparation and has great industrial application potential.
Technical Issues / Solutions: nickel-based catalyst; self-supported electrode
